method: Official web pages read via browser research; original source texts are not bundled. Notes are original paraphrases, not remote page snapshots.

sources.title: Google Search documentation
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Entry point for the documentation, not a promise that every descendant page has been reproduced.

sources.title: Google Search Essentials
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Meeting the essentials establishes eligibility, not guaranteed crawling, indexing, ranking, or display.

sources.title: Technical requirements
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Publicly reachable content, a successful response and indexable content are distinct from actual indexing. A robots block is not a noindex instruction.

sources.title: Spam policies
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Review intent and execution, including scaled content abuse, link spam, cloaking and site reputation abuse. Third-party content is not automatically abuse. Recheck the current regional treatment, especially the EEA.

sources.title: SEO Starter Guide
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use useful content, understandable organization and accessible pages rather than speculative ranking formulas.

sources.title: How Search works
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Discovery, crawling, indexing and serving are different stages. Diagnose the failed stage before prescribing a fix.

sources.title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Assess original value, reliability, authorship and audience satisfaction. Do not invent a numerical E-E-A-T score or universal word-count requirement.

sources.title: Guidance on using generative AI content
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: AI-assisted production is not automatically prohibited; accuracy and added value matter. Scaled production without value can violate spam policies. Merchant Center AI-label requirements are a separate implementation concern.

sources.title: Optimizing for AI search
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: The current guide emphasizes original useful content and ordinary SEO rather than special AI markup. Google Search does not use LLMS.txt; the guide also references Search generative AI participation controls.

sources.title: AI features and your website
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Indexability and snippet eligibility matter for supporting links in AI search. Reconcile older reporting or participation wording with the newer guide and current Search Console documentation.

sources.title: Advice about third-party SEO tools
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: A third-party score, audit label or recommendation is not automatically a Google requirement.

sources.title: Documentation updates
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use dated entries to identify additions, removals and changed eligibility. A documentation update date is not necessarily the date a Search behavior changed.

sources.title: Write high-quality reviews
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Demonstrate substantive evaluation, evidence and meaningful comparisons; do not manufacture testing or personal experience.

sources.title: Search generative AI control
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: The current help page describes participation controls, property inheritance and a Generative AI performance report link. Detailed report dimensions and API availability were not independently reviewed. Controls for Search participation and model training are different.

sources.title: Introduction to robots.txt
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Robots.txt controls crawler access, not confidentiality and not reliable removal of indexed URLs.

sources.title: How Google interprets robots.txt
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Rules are scoped to protocol, hostname and port. Google does not support noindex or crawl-delay as robots.txt directives. Match behavior needs a real parser or authoritative tests.

sources.title: Robots meta tags and HTTP headers
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Distinguish indexing and preview controls from crawl access. Google must be able to retrieve an instruction to process it. Prefer valid document structure; do not assume a robots meta outside head is ignored.

sources.title: Block indexing with noindex
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: A crawlable noindex response can prevent indexing. Blocking retrieval can prevent Google from seeing noindex.

sources.title: Build and submit a sitemap
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Sitemaps aid discovery rather than guarantee indexing. Use absolute canonical URLs and truthful last-modification times; limits are 50,000 URLs and 50 MB uncompressed per sitemap.

sources.title: Canonicalization
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Canonical annotations are signals, not absolute commands. Align internal links, redirects and sitemap choices; preserve genuinely distinct pages.

sources.title: Site moves with URL changes
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Map old URLs to relevant equivalents, redirect deliberately, update references and monitor both properties. Avoid redirecting unrelated retired pages to the homepage.

sources.title: HTTP status codes, network and DNS errors
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Distinguish successful pages, redirects, not-found responses and server or network failures. A successful status with error content may be treated as a soft 404.

sources.title: JavaScript SEO basics
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Inspect raw responses and rendered output. Initial noindex can prevent rendering, so do not rely on JavaScript removing it. Avoid conflicting canonical signals between initial and rendered HTML.

sources.title: Managing crawl budget
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Prioritize crawl efficiency for genuinely large or rapidly changing sites with evidence of a bottleneck; do not presume every small site has a crawl-budget problem.

sources.title: Faceted navigation
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Facets can generate effectively unbounded URL spaces. Separate useful indexable landing pages from combinations that should not consume crawl resources.

sources.title: Verifying Google crawler requests
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: A user-agent string is not proof of Google identity. Use documented IP ranges or reverse DNS followed by matching forward resolution.

sources.title: Mobile-first indexing best practices
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Maintain meaningful content, metadata, structured data and resource accessibility on the mobile version rather than optimizing desktop alone.

sources.title: Link best practices
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use discoverable anchor links with href and meaningful context. Qualify paid and user-generated links appropriately; there is no universal optimal link count.

sources.title: URL structure best practices
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use understandable, stable URLs and avoid accidental duplicate or unbounded parameter spaces.

sources.title: Pagination and incremental loading
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Expose persistent, crawlable URLs for paginated content. Distinct result pages should not all claim that page one is their canonical equivalent.

sources.title: Localized versions of pages
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Language alternates require coherent self and reciprocal references. Language or region annotations do not replace canonicalization or actual localization.

sources.title: Managing multi-regional sites
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Make language and regional versions accessible at stable URLs; avoid forcing all visitors and crawlers through location-based redirects.

sources.title: Control what you share with Google
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Choose access, indexing and preview controls according to the outcome. Search controls are not a substitute for authentication.

sources.title: Remove information from Google
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Temporary search removals and durable removal or access control are different operations. Verify ownership and inspect URL variants before requesting changes.

sources.title: Website testing and Google Search
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Run genuine visitor tests without crawler-targeted cloaking. Use appropriate temporary behavior and clean up experiments when complete.

sources.title: AMP on Google Search
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: AMP is an optional implementation path. Recheck current serving guidance rather than assuming legacy AMP cache, viewer or signed-exchange requirements.

sources.title: Using the Indexing API
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: The API is limited to supported JobPosting pages or BroadcastEvent embedded in VideoObject. Notification acceptance does not prove that a URL is indexed.

sources.title: Title links
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use descriptive, distinct page titles and consistent visible headings. Google can generate a different title link; a fixed character count is not a guaranteed display rule.

sources.title: Snippets
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Snippets can be query-dependent and may come from page content rather than the supplied meta description. Preview controls limit eligibility without guaranteeing exact presentation.

sources.title: Site names
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Provide consistent homepage identity and supported WebSite information. A preference does not guarantee the displayed site name.

sources.title: Favicon in search results
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: At review, the guide specified square icons of at least 8 by 8 pixels and recommended larger than 48 by 48. Listed formats were BMP, GIF, ICO, PNG, JPEG, PPM and TIFF; do not assume SVG is supported here.

sources.title: Google Images best practices
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Make useful images accessible, understandable from nearby content and sensibly described. A preferred image or metadata suggestion is not a guaranteed selection.

sources.title: Video SEO best practices
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Check watch-page relevance, video prominence, accessibility and stable thumbnail resources. Ordinary page indexing is not the same as video indexing.

sources.title: Page experience
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Evaluate the visitor experience rather than a single synthetic SEO score. Good experience does not guarantee top ranking.

sources.title: Core Web Vitals
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Separate real-user experience from lab debugging and measure the relevant page templates. Avoid claiming a ranking change follows mechanically from a performance score.

sources.title: Discover and your website
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Discover eligibility is not guaranteed distribution. Treat feed traffic as a separate, variable surface rather than predictable keyword demand.

sources.title: Preferred sources
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use the current supported preferred-source mechanism where available. Do not promise a ranking boost or fabricate readers selecting a publisher.

sources.title: Regionally available features
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Eligibility and presentation can depend on location and publisher type, including EEA and Türkiye-specific features. Verify the current jurisdiction and exact feature.

sources.title: Guidelines for explicit content
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use accurate classification and appropriate technical separation. Do not attempt to evade safety classification or filters.

sources.title: Analyze social and video content
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use the current documentation and actual property access to understand supported social or video analysis. Do not assume a website report exposes all off-site engagement metrics.

sources.title: Structured data feature gallery
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Resolve current feature guides from this maintained gallery. Feature syntax, content requirements, availability and actual rich-result display are separate questions.

sources.title: Introduction to structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use supported formats and the specific Google feature guide. Schema.org vocabulary validity alone does not establish Google rich-result eligibility.

sources.title: General structured data guidelines
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Markup must truthfully represent the page and satisfy feature policies. Passing a syntax test does not guarantee eligibility or display. A structured-data-only manual action is different from an ordinary ranking penalty.

sources.title: Product structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Choose the product feature matching the page and commercial intent. Product snippets and merchant listings have distinct eligibility and property expectations.

sources.title: Merchant listing structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Validate real offer facts, currency, price, availability and current feature-specific properties. The full property table was not reproduced; read the guide before generating production markup.

sources.title: Product variant structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Model real product variants and their relationships; align URLs, offer facts and the selected variant visible to users.

sources.title: Organization structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Represent the actual organization consistently. Organization markup does not itself prove verification, eligibility for every feature, or higher rankings.

sources.title: Local business structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use accurate business and location facts. Website markup does not replace management of a Google Business Profile.

sources.title: Review snippet structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use genuine eligible reviews rather than fabricated or undisclosed incentivized reviews. Self-serving business reviews have feature-specific restrictions.

sources.title: Subscription and paywalled content
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Identify paywalled content accurately with the supported markup. Markup is not authorization to bypass a paywall or expose protected user content.

sources.title: Job posting structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Apply job markup to actual eligible job detail pages and handle expired jobs correctly. The supported Indexing API scope does not extend to unrelated URLs.

sources.title: Discussion forum structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Match real user discussion content, authorship and hierarchy rather than disguising a promotional page as a forum.

sources.title: Q&A structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Distinguish a genuine user-answer question page from a publisher-written FAQ. Do not relabel FAQs merely to seek a different rich result.

sources.title: Article structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Represent visible article identity, authorship, dates and imagery accurately and use the current feature-specific guide.

sources.title: Breadcrumb structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Express a coherent user-facing hierarchy with eligible BreadcrumbList markup rather than treating the URL text as the only valid hierarchy.

sources.title: Event structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use actual events, correct dates, locations and status. Recheck eligibility instead of marking ordinary business hours or promotions as events.

sources.title: Recipe structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use the recipe feature only for actual recipe content, with factual instructions and supporting properties visible on the page.

sources.title: Software app structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Read the current guide for an actual software application page. Do not invent price, ratings or platform support to fill missing fields.

sources.title: Profile page structured data
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use supported profile markup for pages with a real profile focus and factual creator identity.

sources.title: Ecommerce best practices
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Connect crawlable site structure, truthful product data and a deliberate launch plan; Merchant Center and website SEO are distinct integrations.

sources.title: Launch an ecommerce website
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Choose a launch strategy deliberately and verify public accessibility and inventory quality before submission or promotion.

sources.title: Get started with Search Console
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use authorized property data to inspect performance and indexing; do not treat console data access or ownership as implied by a public URL.

sources.title: Debugging Search traffic drops
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Separate technical failures, demand changes, ranking changes and reporting effects. Segment comparable periods before deciding a cause.

sources.title: Core updates
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Check rollout dates and completion before assessing an update. Guidance recommends waiting at least a full week after completion for the suggested comparison; urgent technical incidents should still be fixed immediately.

sources.title: Ranking systems guide
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Google describes systems, not a public exact ranking formula. Do not convert individual concepts into invented weights or guarantees.

sources.title: Prevent abuse on your site
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Prevent and moderate spam on sites that accept public contributions. Do not infer a manual action merely from a traffic change.

sources.title: The site: search operator
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: The operator is a limited diagnostic aid, not a complete indexed-URL inventory or definitive count.

sources.title: Manual actions report
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: Use the actual authorized report and stated scope. Fix the documented issues before an explicitly authorized reconsideration request; do not invent a manual action from ranking changes.

sources.title: Agent Skills specification
sources.review_scope: Relevant guidance reviewed; not every linked page or property table.
sources.note: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md containing name and description frontmatter. Progressive references and scripts keep the entrypoint focused.

sources.title: URL Inspection help — live verification required
sources.review_scope: Read this source live before relying on its detailed requirements.
sources.note: The direct help-page fetch did not succeed during package creation. Follow the current Search Console UI/help before relying on detailed report behavior.
